title: Roadshow ops pocket notes & receipts
content:
Purpose: compact scratchpad for quick ops during multi-city roadshow pop-ups. Use this as the single pocket reference: what to pack, who to call, quick expense rules, and receipt naming conventions.

Day-of checklist (quick):
- Confirm booth ship tracking (UPS account: Redwood-Marketing-894). If delay > 2h, call Fleet Courier (SF) 415-555-0192).
- Power: 2x Anker 20,000mAh banks (label with orange tape) + 1x 65W laptop brick. Bring 2 US-C -> HDMI adapters.
- Signage: hanging banner (2 poles), pop-up header, 3 floor stickers. Extra gaff tape + zip ties in small pouch.
- Badge box: printed roster + sharpies + badge lanyards (50).
- Swag: 150 stickers, 50 pens, 100 postcards. Keep extra postcards in marked envelope.
- Payment terminals: Square device + charging cable; backup merchant phone unlocked.
- Local SIM / hotspot: if we lose WiFi, hotspot card in wallet (SIM vendor: GreenSIM 415-555-0188).
- On-call chain: Primary: Priya Shah (mobile), Backup: Jon Kim (mobile), Ops escalations: Marisa Lopez (pager).

Vendor & logistics contacts (short):
- Fleet Courier (local same-day) — contact: Sam Rivera, sam@fleetcourier.example, 415-555-0192.
- GreenWrap Logistics (booth install) — ops@greenwrap.example, 415-555-0127.
- CivicCenter Marriott — Events: Laura Chen, laura.chen@marriott.example, 415-555-0100 (use group code REDW23).
- Local A/V support — SoundWorks Bay Area, av@swbay.example, on-call 24/7: 415-555-0999.

Expense & receipts quick rules (for fast reimbursement):
- Immediate: Snap every receipt with phone camera. Use expense app (Concur) within 48 hours. Tag with event code: ROAD2026 and city (e.g., ROAD2026-SF).
- Naming convention (file/photo): ROAD2026_CITY_VENDOR_AMOUNT_YYYYMMDD (example: ROAD2026_SF_TaxiUber_24.30_20260214.jpg).
- Meals: per-diem allowed up to $75/day (US domestic). For team meals with customers, use "Client Entertainment" category and note attendee names and company.
- Swag purchases: code = SWAG-ROAD. Keep itemized invoice; no reimburse without invoice.
- Shipping fees: use P-Card when possible. If using personal card, submit full invoice + tracking and indicate reason.
- Foreign currency: include converted amount and exchange rate (or use bank card conversion slip). Keep VAT/GST invoices when applicable — mark as "refundable" if we plan to reclaim.
- Taxis/Ubers: screenshot of trip + fare; include start/end addresses.

Receipt capture tips:
- If receipt paper is crumpled, flatten on dark background. Use app auto-crop and attach to expense line.
- For fuel/parking: capture pump/garage total and the payment card last 4 digits if available.

Sample quick categories for Concur (pick one):
- TRAVEL:Air, TRAVEL:Hotel, TRAVEL:Taxi, EXP:Meals, EXP:Swag, EXP:Shipping, EXP:VenueFees, EXP:AV

On-site notes & decisions (scratch):
- If venue WiFi is poor, enable phone hotspot and DHCP static IP for demo laptop.
- Demo environment: use local model variant (cache warmed) for demo to avoid cold-start. Load demo kit 1 hour before doors.
- Fallback model: rdx-small-prod if rdx-large has latency spikes. Note model change in demo notes.
- Lead capture: two QR codes: "Schedule a follow-up" and "Receive a trial". Make sure CRM mapping in Zapier is enabled (contact: eng-infra zap owner).

Reimbursements: who to cc
- Finance: finance-ops@redwood.ai
- Your manager: cc for approvals. For P-Card disputes, include procurement@redwood.ai.

Post-event wrap (tasks):
- Upload receipts + reconcile against P&L spreadsheet (link in linked_artifacts).
- Return rented items within 48 hours. Log tracking number in the Roadshow spreadsheet.
- Short postmortem: 3 bullets — what worked, what failed, immediate fix for next city. Submit within 5 business days.

Notes to self (todo):
- Confirm extra microphone for demo presenter (issue with background noise last time).
- Print 20 extra one-sheets focused on "Dedicated vs Hosted: quick decision tree".
- Double-check Square device firmware before first show.

Emergency wallet (quick):
- P-Card wallet (green leather) — contains P-Card ending in 7321. For any vendor-card charge > $2k, call procurement first.
- Cash float: $200 in small bills for tips/parking.

Useful quick Slack commands:
- /shifts roadshow-ops to see coverage
- /expensetemplate roadshow to pre-fill Concur form

This doc is a live pocket scratchpad — edit during travel, but keep receipts immutable (attach photo + timestamp). If in doubt about categorization, flag and submit as "needs-review" and finance will follow up.

— Evan
(last updated 2026-03-10)
